title: Giving Opinions
ringkas: Menyatakan pendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju
goals: menyatakan pendapat: [[I think ...]], [[In my opinion, ...]], [[I believe ...]]
menyatakan setuju dan tidak setuju dengan sopan
memberi alasan dengan [[because]] dan akibat dengan [[so]]
menyusun opini pendek yang jelas: pendapat, alasan, kesimpulan

lesson.text: Apakah seragam sekolah sebaiknya dipertahankan? Apakah bermain game itu baik? Setiap orang bisa punya pendapat berbeda. Di **Unit 6 Kelas 9** kamu belajar **menyampaikan pendapat**, **setuju atau tidak setuju**, dan **memberi alasan** dengan sopan.

lesson.title: 1. Menyatakan pendapat
table: [[In my opinion, homework is too much.]]
[[As far as I'm concerned, sports are healthy.]]
[[It seems to me that we need more time.]]

lesson.title: 2. Setuju dan tidak setuju
table: Aku juga berpikir begitu. / Kamu benar sekali.
Aku setuju sebagian, tapi ... / Itu benar, tapi ...
[[I'm not sure about that.]] / [[I see your point, but ...]]
Aku kurang yakin. / Aku paham maksudmu, tapi ...

lesson.title: Tidak setuju dengan sopan
lesson.text: Jangan langsung bilang "No, you're wrong!". Mulailah dengan menghargai: [[I see your point, but I think ...]] atau [[That's an interesting idea, but ...]] Lalu beri **alasan**.

lesson.title: 3. Alasan dan akibat
table: [[I like English because it is fun.]]
[[It was raining, so we stayed home.]]
[[The movie was long, but it was interesting.]]
[[Games are fun. However, they can waste time.]]
[[Exercise is good for health. It also makes us happy.]]
[[Many sports are fun, for example, football and badminton.]]

lesson.title: 4. Struktur opini pendek
table: [[First, uniforms make all students equal. Second, they save time in the morning.]]
[[So, I believe uniforms are good for students.]]

lines.en: In my opinion, school uniforms are useful. They make all students look equal.
lines.id: Menurutku, seragam sekolah bermanfaat. Seragam membuat semua siswa terlihat setara.

lines.en: I see your point, but I don't agree completely. Uniforms are sometimes uncomfortable.
lines.id: Aku paham maksudmu, tapi aku tidak sepenuhnya setuju. Seragam kadang tidak nyaman.

lines.en: That's true. However, they also save time in the morning because we don't need to choose clothes.
lines.id: Itu benar. Namun seragam juga menghemat waktu di pagi hari karena kita tidak perlu memilih baju.

lines.en: Hmm, I agree with that. So maybe uniforms are good, but they should be comfortable.
lines.id: Hmm, aku setuju soal itu. Jadi mungkin seragam itu baik, tapi harus nyaman.

lesson.title: Contoh opini: Should students bring phones to school?

lines.en: I think students shouldn't bring phones to school.
lines.id: Menurutku siswa sebaiknya tidak membawa ponsel ke sekolah. (Statement)

lines.en: First, phones can distract students in class. Second, some students may play games instead of studying.
lines.id: Pertama, ponsel bisa mengganggu konsentrasi di kelas. Kedua, sebagian siswa bisa bermain game, bukan belajar. (Reasons)

lines.en: However, phones can be useful in an emergency. So students may bring them, but they must keep them in their bags during lessons.
lines.id: Namun ponsel berguna saat darurat. Jadi siswa boleh membawanya, tetapi harus disimpan di tas saat pelajaran. (Conclusion)

items: Setuju: [[I agree.]] / [[Exactly!]]. Tidak setuju: [[I don't agree.]], sebaiknya dengan sopan: [[I see your point, but ...]]

Sebagian orang berpikir siswa sebaiknya memakai ponsel di kelas. Menurut mereka, ponsel membantu mencari informasi dengan cepat. Misalnya, siswa dapat mencari kata di aplikasi kamus.
Namun, saya tidak setuju. Menurut saya, ponsel mengganggu. Siswa sering bermain game atau membuka media sosial alih-alih mendengarkan. Karena itu, menurut saya ponsel sebaiknya disimpan di dalam tas selama pelajaran, kecuali bila guru meminta siswa memakainya.

options: Phones should not be used in class.
qs.q: What is the writer's opinion?

options: They are cheap, so every student can buy one.
They are fun, so students enjoy the lesson more.
They make students sleep during the long lesson.
qs.q: What is one reason for using phones in class?

qs.exp: Teks: "play games or check social media".
options: Play games or check social media
Take photos of the teacher and their friends
Call their parents during the lesson
Read books quietly from the school library
qs.q: What do students often do with phones instead of listening?

options: When the teacher asks them to
Whenever they want, even when the teacher speaks
During breaks only, and never in the lesson
Never, not even when the teacher asks
qs.q: When can students use phones, according to the writer?

read.text:
Some people think students should use phones in class. In their opinion, phones are helpful for finding information quickly. For example, students can look up a word in a dictionary application.
However, I disagree. In my opinion, phones are distracting. Students often play games or check social media instead of listening. Therefore, I think phones should be kept in a bag during lessons, except when the teacher asks students to use them.
read.title: Should Students Use Phones in Class?

Ani: Menurutku tinggal di desa lebih baik daripada di kota. Udaranya segar dan orang-orangnya ramah.
Budi: Aku tidak setuju denganmu. Menurutku kota lebih baik karena ada lebih banyak pekerjaan dan sekolah yang bagus. Ani: Itu poin yang bagus. Tetapi di sisi lain, kota bising dan padat. Budi: Kamu ada benarnya, tetapi aku tetap lebih suka kota.

qs.exp: Ani: "The air is fresh and the people are friendly."
options: The air is fresh and people are friendly.
There are more jobs, and the salaries are higher.
The schools are better, and the roads are wider.
It is cheaper, and there are more shopping malls.
qs.q: Why does Ani prefer the village?

options: There are more jobs and good schools.
It is quiet, and there is very little traffic.
The air is fresh, and the people are friendly.
It is cheap, and the houses are bigger.
qs.q: Why does Budi prefer the city?
What is a disadvantage of cities, according to Ani?
In the end, what does Budi prefer?

read.text:
Ani: I think living in a village is better than living in a city. The air is fresh and the people are friendly.
Budi: I don't agree with you. In my opinion, a city is better because there are more jobs and good schools. Ani: That's a good point. But on the other hand, cities are noisy and crowded. Budi: You have a point, but I still prefer the city.
read.title: Which Is Better?

read.id:
Beberapa siswa berpikir sekolah sebaiknya mulai lebih siang. Menurut saya, ini ide yang baik. Remaja membutuhkan lebih banyak tidur, dan mereka sering merasa lelah di pagi hari. Karena itu, mereka tidak bisa berkonsentrasi dengan baik di pelajaran pertama.
Namun, orang lain tidak setuju. Mereka bilang siswa akan malas jika sekolah mulai lebih siang. Saya setuju sebagian dengan mereka, tetapi saya pikir mulai lebih siang lebih baik untuk kesehatan. Di sisi lain, orang tua harus mengubah jadwal kerja mereka, jadi ide ini tidak sederhana.

qs.exp: Teks: "In my opinion, this is a good idea."
options: A later start is a good idea.
qs.q: What is the writer's opinion?
Why do teenagers feel tired in the morning?

qs.exp: Teks: "students will be lazy if school starts later".
qs.q: What do other people fear?
Pasangkan ungkapan dengan fungsinya:
Teenagers ___ (need) more sleep.
They say students ___ be lazy.

qs.answer: In my opinion, this is a good idea.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Menurut saya, ini ide yang baik."

read.text:
Some students think school should start later. In my opinion, this is a good idea. Teenagers need more sleep, and they often feel tired in the morning. Therefore, they cannot concentrate well in the first lesson.
However, other people disagree. They say students will be lazy if school starts later. I partly agree with them, but I think a later start is better for health. On the other hand, parents must change their work schedule, so the idea is not simple.
read.title: Should Schools Start Later?

read.id:
Anna: Menurutku PR itu perlu karena membantu siswa mengingat pelajaran. Tanpanya, kita mungkin lupa semuanya. Budi: Aku paham maksudmu, tetapi aku tidak sepenuhnya setuju. PR yang terlalu banyak bisa membuat siswa lelah, dan mereka mungkin tidak cukup tidur.
Anna: Itu benar. Mungkin guru sebaiknya memberi PR lebih sedikit, tetapi tugas yang lebih menarik. Budi: Aku setuju dengan itu. Menurutku, siswa juga harus punya waktu untuk istirahat dan bermain. Anna: Kita mungkin bisa meminta guru membahasnya di kelas.

Without homework, we ___ forget the lesson. (mungkin)

qs.answer: In my opinion, students should also have time to rest.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Menurutku, siswa juga harus punya waktu istirahat."

read.text:
Anna: I think homework is necessary because it helps students remember the lesson. Without it, we might forget everything. Budi: I see your point, but I don't agree completely. Too much homework can make students tired, and they may not sleep enough.
Anna: That's true. Perhaps teachers should give less homework, but more interesting tasks. Budi: I agree with that. In my opinion, students should also have time to rest and play. Anna: We might ask our teacher to discuss it in class.
read.title: Is Homework Necessary?

Dina: Online learning is useful, isn't it? Rani: Yes, it is. But it isn't perfect, is it? Sometimes the internet is slow. Dina: That's true. Teachers can't see everyone clearly, can they?
Rani: No, they can't. However, I think students learn at their own speed. Don't you agree? Dina: I partly agree. In my opinion, a mix of both is better. Rani: You've got a point. Let's tell our teacher.

read.focus: Preposisi opini: in my opinion, on the other hand, in favor of, agree with
read.id:
Dina: Menurut saya, siswa sebaiknya memakai seragam. Saya mendukungnya. Di sekolah, seragam membuat semua orang setara. Tom: Saya tidak setuju denganmu. Di sisi lain, seragam bisa mahal bagi sebagian keluarga.
Dina: Itu benar. Tetapi pada saat yang sama, seragam menghemat uang untuk pakaian sehari-hari. Tom: Aku menentang aturan ketat, tetapi aku setuju denganmu dalam satu hal. Pada akhirnya, kita sebaiknya bertanya kepada orang tua. Dina: Ide bagus. Mari kita bicarakan di rapat.

qs.q: What is Dina in favor of?
Which sentence has a mistake?
Choose the correct phrase: "___ the other hand, uniforms can be expensive."
Pasangkan ungkapan dengan artinya:

qs.id: Lengkapi dengan in, on, atau at:
qs.q: ___ my opinion, students should wear uniforms.
I don't agree ___ you.

qs.answer: Let's talk about it at the meeting.
qs.exp: talk about + topik, at the meeting.
qs.q: Susun kalimat dari cerita: "Mari kita bicarakan di rapat."

read.text:
Dina: In my opinion, students should wear uniforms. I'm in favor of them. At school, they make everyone equal. Tom: I don't agree with you. On the other hand, they can be expensive for some families.
Dina: That's true. But at the same time, they save money on daily clothes. Tom: I'm against strict rules, but I agree with you on one point. In the end, we should ask our parents. Dina: Good idea. Let's talk about it at the meeting.
read.title: In My Opinion

Dina: Menurutku, seragam adalah ide yang baik. Seragam membuat sekolah tampak rapi. Alasan penting adalah semua orang merasa setara. Tom: Aku paham maksudmu, tetapi seragam bisa tidak nyaman saat panas.
Dina: Itu argumen yang adil. Mungkin sekolah bisa menyediakan bahan yang lebih sejuk. Tom: Itu akan jadi solusi yang mudah. Sekarang waktu yang tepat untuk bertanya kepada kepala sekolah. Dina: Mari kita tulis surat singkat.

read.text:
Dina: In my opinion, uniforms are a good idea. They make the school look neat. An important reason is that everyone feels equal. Tom: I see your point, but a uniform can be uncomfortable in the heat.
Dina: That is a fair argument. Maybe the school can offer a cooler fabric. Tom: That would be an easy solution. It is the right time to ask the principal. Dina: Let's write a short letter.
